events.title: Sulayman's Berber forces defeat Caliph Muhammad II at Qantish
events.description: Berber forces led by Sulayman ibn al-Hakam defeated the Umayyad caliph of Córdoba Muhammad II al-Mahdi, who had seized power in a revolt that February. Sulayman ousted him and became the fifth caliph of Córdoba.

events.title: The Council of Constance opens
events.description: A general council met at Constance to end the Great Schism, in which three men claimed the papacy. It deposed two, accepted the resignation of the third and elected Martin V, but also condemned Jan Hus to the stake.

events.title: The Catholicon, the first Breton dictionary, is printed at Tréguier
events.description: The printer Jehan Calvez of Tréguier published the first edition of the Catholicon, a dictionary of Breton, French and Latin compiled in 1464 by Jehan Lagadeuc. The first dictionary of both Breton and French, it contained six thousand entries.

events.title: Akbar's Mughal army defeats Hemu at the Second Battle of Panipat
events.description: North of Delhi, the army of the young Mughal emperor Akbar, under his regent Bairam Khan, faced Hemu, who had taken Delhi weeks earlier. Struck in the eye by an arrow, Hemu was captured and killed, and Mughal rule was restored.

events.title: Guy Fawkes is arrested beneath Parliament
events.description: Shortly after midnight, Guy Fawkes was caught guarding gunpowder in a cellar under the House of Lords, foiling a Catholic plot to kill James I. Bonfires were lit in celebration, beginning the tradition of Bonfire Night.

events.title: British and French troops repel the Russians at Inkerman
events.description: In thick fog, Russian columns attacked British positions above Sevastopol. Fighting in small groups with little direction, the British, reinforced by the French, held the ridge in what became known as the 'Soldiers' Battle'.

events.title: Woodrow Wilson is elected US president
events.description: With Theodore Roosevelt and William Howard Taft splitting the Republican vote, the Democrat Woodrow Wilson won the presidency. He created the Federal Reserve and led America into the First World War.

events.title: Saddam Hussein is sentenced to death
events.description: An Iraqi tribunal sentenced Saddam Hussein to hang for the killing of 148 Shia men and boys from Dujail after a 1982 assassination attempt. He was executed on 30 December 2006.
